content: Oyddu Mukulu Asaa
Guutha wodepe guye, daro asay Yesuusako shiiqidosona. Asaas miyabay dhayin Yesuusi ba tamaareta baako xeegidi,
“Ha asay taara heedzu gallas gakanaw gam7idi, aykoka miyaba demmiboonna gisho, tana asay qadhethees.
Taani asaa koshara soo yeddiko asay bishe ogen daaburidi kundana, bagga asay haahosoope yidosona” yaagis.
Yesuusa tamaareti zaaridi, “Ha mela biittan ha asa ubbaa muzanaw gidiya kathi demmanaw danda7ey oonee?” yaagidosona.
Yesuusi entako, “Hintew aapun uythi de7ii?” yaagidi oychis. Enti zaaridi, “Laapun uythi de7ees” yaagidosona.
Yesuusi asay sa7an uttana mela kiittis. Yaatidi, laapun uythaa ekidi Xoossaa galati simmidi he uythaa menthidi, asaas gishana mela ba tamaaretas immis. Iya tamaareti asaas gishidosona.
Entaw qassi guutha laafa moloti de7oosona. Yesuusi he molota gisho Xoossaa galatidi, asaas gishana mela ba tamaareta kiittis.
Asa ubbay midi kallidosona. Iya tamaareti attida tiifiya laapun gayta kumethi denthidosona.
Kathaa mida asaa tayboy oyddu mukulu gidana. Hessafe guye, Yesuusi asa yeddis.
I qassi ba tamaaretara ellesi wogolon gelidi Dalmanuuta biitta bis.
Malaata Be7anaw Oychida oysha
Farsaaweti yidi Yesuusa paacanaw koyidi, salope bantana malaata bessaana mela Yesuusara palama oykidosona.
Yesuusi tooki shempidi, “Ha wodiya asay ayis malaata koyii? Taani hintew tuma odayis; ha wodiya asaas ay malaatika imetenna” yaagis.
I enta yan yeggi aggidi zaari wogolon gelidi abbaafe hefinthi pinnis.
Farsaawetanne Herodiisa Irsho
Iya tamaareti kathi efanaysa dogidosona; entaw wogoluwa giddon issi uythaafe hari baawa.
Yesuusi entako, “Hintena erite. Farsaaweta irshuwafenne Herodiisa irshuwafe naagetite” yaagidi kiittis.
Enti banta giddon, “I haysa gey nuus uythi bayna gishosa” yaagidosona.
Yesuusi enti geysa eridi entako, “Hintew uythi bayna gisho ayis odeteetii? Ha77ika ereketii? Woyko akeekeketii? Hinte wozanay doccidee?
Hintew ayfey de7ishin be7eketii? Haythi de7ishin si7eketii? Hinte akeeketii?
Taani ichashu uythaa ichashu mukulu asaas bathida wode aapun gayta kumethi tiife denthidetii?” yaagis. Entika, “Tammanne nam7u gayta kumethi” yaagidosona.
“Hessadaka, taani laapun uythaa oyddu mukulu asaas bathida wode aapun gayta kumetha tiife denthidetii?” yaagis. Enti, “Laapun gayta kumethi denthida” yaagidosona.
Yaatin, “Ha77ika akeekibeketii?” yaagis.
Beetesaydan De7iya Issi Qooqe
Enti Beetesayda katamaa bidosona. Guutha asati qooqe uraa Yesuusako ehidi he uraa bochana mela iya woossidosona.
Yesuusi qooqe uraa kushiya oykidi katamaape gaxa kessis. Iya ayfiyan cuttidi ba kushiya iya bolla wothidi, “New aykoy bentii?” yaagidi oychis.
Uray dhoqu gidi xeellidi, “Taw asay bentees, shin asay hemetishe mithi daanees” yaagis.
Hessafe guye, Yesuusi zaaridi, uraa ayfiyan ba kushiya wothis. Uray loythi xeellis, iya ayfey paxis, ubbaba geeshshidi be7is.
Yesuusi addiyako, “Ne soo ba, shin gutaa gelopa” yaagidi kiittis.
Phexroosa Markatetha
Yesuusi ba tamaaretara Qisaare Filphoosa matan de7iya gutaa bis. Enti bishin oge bolla Yesuusi, “Tana asay oona goonna?” yaagidi ba tamaareta oychis.
Iya tamaareti, “Issi issi asay nena, ‘Xammaqiya Yohaanisa’ goosona; harati, ‘Eeliyaasa goosona’ qassi harati, ‘Nabetape issuwa’ goosona” yaagidosona.
Yesuusi entako, “Yaatin hinte tana oona geetii?” yaagidi oychis. Phexroosi, “Neeni Kiristoosa” yaagidi zaaris.
Yesuusi, “Tabaa oodeska odopite” yaagidi enta kiittis.
Yesuusi Bana Gakana Waayiya Odis

Yesuusi ba tamaaretako, “Asa Na7ay, daro meto ekanaw bessees; cimati, kahine halaqatinne higge astamaareti iya ixanaw bessees. Enti iya wodhanawunne I, heedzu gallasape guye, hayqope dendanaw bessees” yaagidi enta tamaarsis.
I hessa entaw geeshshidi odis. Phexroosi iya issi bagga zaaridi hanqetis.
Shin Yesuusi guye simmidi, ba tamaareta xeellidi, Phexroosa hanqetidi, “Ha Xalahey, taape haaka. Neeni asi dosiyaba qopaasape attishin, Xoossay dosiyaba qopaka” yaagis.
Yesuusa Kaaloy Cigisiya Gate
Qassika Yesuusi daro asaanne ba tamaareta baako xeegidi, “Tana kaallanaw koyiya oonika bana kaddo; ba masqaliya tookidi tana kaalo.
Ba shempuwa ashshanaw koyiya uray dhaysana. Shin ta gishonne Wongela gisho ba shempuwa dhaysiya uray ashshana.
Issi asi sa7an de7iya ubbaba baw shiishidi, ba shempuwa dhaysiko iya ay maaddanee?
Issi asi ba shempuwa wozanaw ay immanaw danda7ii?
Xoossaa ammanonna ha iita yeletethan, issi asi tananinne ta qaalan yeellatiko, Asa Na7ay, qassi ba Aawa bonchon geeshsha kiitanchotara yaa wode iyan yeellatana” yaagis.
